entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The red-aligned praetor of New Phyrexia who defied its leadership, sheltered Mirran survivors and rebelled against Elesh Norn; presumed dead.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-conquered plane (formerly Mirrodin) that Urabrask helped as praetor.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor and leader of New Phyrexia who laid waste to Urabrask's domain and ordered his execution.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: Praetor who, like Urabrask, had philosophical differences with Phyrexian doctrine.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Founder of Phyrexia whose Grand Evolution Urabrask renamed the Great Work.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: Mirrodin survivors who resisted Phyrexia and sheltered in the Furnace Layer.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: Layer of New Phyrexia controlled by Urabrask, sealed off from other Phyrexian factions.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: Blue-aligned Phyrexian faction paranoid about the sealed Furnace Layer.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought to double-cross Norn and transported Urabrask to New Capenna.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: Plane to which Urabrask was transported.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: Planeswalker tasked by Urabrask with bringing him Halo and Elspeth Tirel.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker whose presence Urabrask claimed would tip the war to the Mirrans.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Someone Urabrask asked Vivien to bring to him.

entities.name: Steel Thanes
entities.description: Phyrexians who refused to bow to Elesh Norn and joined the rebel faction.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker helped by Urabrask to reach Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: Planeswalker helped by Urabrask to reach Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Destination of the Mirran squadron helped by Urabrask.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion after which Urabrask is presumed dead.

events.summary: After Phyrexia conquers Mirrodin, Urabrask lets Mirran survivors take refuge in the Furnace Layer and seals it from other factions.
events.quote: Urabrask allowed the Mirran survivors to take refuge in the Furnace Layer of the plane

events.summary: Elesh Norn lays waste to Urabrask's domain; the Mirrans flee to mountain shelters and Urabrask's red Phyrexians dwell in the Furnace Layer.
events.quote: Inevitably, Elesh Norn laid waste to his domain

events.summary: Tezzeret transports Urabrask to New Capenna; the Planar Bridge badly damages the praetor.
events.quote: The Planar Bridge heavily damaged the praetor's body

events.summary: Urabrask meets Vivien Reid and tasks her with bringing him Halo and Elspeth Tirel.
events.quote: the praetor met with Vivien Reid and tasked her with bringing him Halo and the Planeswalker Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: Urabrask returns to New Phyrexia and openly rebels against Elesh Norn with his Phyrexian faction.
Urabrask helps Chandra and Wrenn and a Mirran squadron reach Realmbreaker.
Urabrask is captured and Elesh Norn orders his execution by quartering; he is reduced to a limbless torso and possibly dies.
events.quote: the Grand Cenobite ordered his execution by quartering

relations.quote: Tezzeret found an unlikely ally in Urabrask
The rebel Phyrexian faction included the Steel Thanes that didn't bow to Elesh Norn.
